newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Barrick estimates shaved.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Barrick estimates shaved.

text.p: - Everen Securities said it lowered its earningns estimates for Barrick Gold Corp based in part on assumptions for gold prices for the next several years.

- Everen sees gold prices at $365/oz., $380/oz. and $400/oz. for 1997, 1998 and 1999. It also said it expects Barrick's gold production will grow very slowly. Based on these factors, Everen said it trimmed per share earnings estimates for 1997, 1998, 1999 and 2000 to $0.70, $0.51, $0.59 and $0.67, respectively, from $0.73, $0.84, $0.99 and $1.21.
